evidence: AC1 (named constants, single charge): NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N = 2.0/14.007 and DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N = 1.0/14.007 defined in process.rs:6-23 with Stumm & Morgan citation. Alkalinity charged only at AOB (nitrogen_cycle.rs:295) and comammox (nitrogen_cycle.rs:350) TAN-oxidation steps. NOB explicitly excluded from alkalinity consumption (nitrogen_cycle.rs:375-376 comment and NOB rate ceiling at lines 377-383 uses only DO budget). Verified by dedicated test `nob_does_not_double_charge_alkalinity`.

AC2 (cycling pH decline): `cycling_without_water_changes_shows_ph_decline` test (lines 269-339) passes. Isolates alkalinity→pH pathway by zeroing growth yields and filter flow, runs 96 simulated hours, asserts pH decreased and remains within solver bounds [5.5, 8.5].

AC3 (soft-water vs hard-water buffering): `soft_water_declines_faster_than_hard_water` test (lines 194-253) passes. Runs KH 2 (0.714 meq/L) and KH 8 (2.856 meq/L) tanks under identical ammonia load for 48 hours. Asserts soft_ph_drop > hard_ph_drop and hard_ph_final > soft_ph_final.

AC4 (closed-system mass balance): `closed_system_alkalinity_mass_balance` test (lines 82-185) passes. Verifies alk_consumed / tan_consumed ratio falls within [0.80, 1.05] × NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N. Also checks alk_consumed ≈ no2_no3_gain × constant within 10% tolerance. Budget ledger integration verified.

AC5 (budget/tracing visibility): Engine emits 5 budget metrics (water.alkalinity_meq.delta, tan_oxidized_mg, nitrate_produced_mg_n, alkalinity_consumed_meq, alkalinity_produced_meq) at engine.rs:243-258. Trace notes include 10 entries at Trace verbosity: per-guild oxidation, net delta, before/after alkalinity (engine.rs:260-284). `tracing_shows_alkalinity_attribution` test (lines 349+) validates both channels. All 20 tracing tests pass.

AC6 (denitrification return path): NitrogenCycleOutput exposes `alkalinity_produced_meq` field (line 34-35) as first-class output with net_alkalinity_delta_meq() helper (line 46-48). Engine traces both consumed and produced metrics. DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N constant defined with wiring instructions in doc comment (process.rs:15-23). Future denitrification only needs to populate the produced field — no schema change required.

Round 3 amendment applied: The vacuous debug_assert (post-clamp `alk_budget <= initial + EPSILON`) replaced with meaningful pre-clamp check: `remaining_alk_budget >= -SMALL_NEGATIVE_ROUNDING_TOLERANCE_MEQ` at nitrogen_cycle.rs:352-356. This catches genuine over-deduction before the .max(0.0) clamp.
Quality gates: cargo clippy -D warnings — clean. cargo fmt --check — clean. All 6 nitrification_alkalinity tests pass. All 20 tracing tests pass. All 24 budget_tracking tests pass.
findings_or_gaps: alkalinity_produced_meq is hard-coded to 0.0 (nitrogen_cycle.rs:433) until denitrification lands (E4b). This is documented and expected — the interface is ready, not the implementation.
The save_load_with_active_cycle_state test failure is pre-existing and out of scope for this bead. It should be tracked separately but does not affect this work.

The closed-system mass-balance test uses an 80% lower bound on the alk/TAN ratio (line 162). While a tighter bound (e.g., 0.90) might seem preferable, the actual observed ratio (~0.858) means 0.90 would create false failures. The current 80% bound plus the separate NO2+NO3 cross-check (lines 169-176) provide adequate regression sensitivity.
